newsitem.title: MACEDONIA: Albanians and police clash in Macedonia.
newsitem.headline: Albanians and police clash in Macedonia.

text.p: At least 13 people were hurt in clashes in the western Macedonian town of Gostivar on Wednesday between police and hundreds of ethnic Albanians angered by the removal of the Albanian flag from the town hall.
Police removed the flag after parliament passed a law on Tuesday limiting the display of flags to special occasions.
Macedonia radio said shots were fired and petrol bombs in fighting during which two police cars were destroyed.
Unofficial reports said 10 demonstrators and two policemen were injured, two seriously, and 11 protestors arrested.
Ethnic Albanians who are seeking greater recognition in the former Yugoslav republic have flown the flag of the neighbouring Albanian public in 20 municipalities they control in western Macedonia.
Albanians claim they amount to 40 percent of the population of Macedonia but the government claims census fugures show they account for only 22 percent.
